ic_name: MIPI CSI-2 (Camera Serial Interface 2, MIPI Alliance)
module_role: Packet-based serial display interface stack inside a SoC, layered as Application → Low Level Protocol → Lane Management → PHY (per DSI §4.1). Provides the wire-level transport for both Video Mode pixel streaming (DPI-2-like) and Command Mode command/parameter delivery (DBI-2-like + DCS).
interconnect_topologies_supported: Point-to-point — host ↔ one peripheral per physical DSI Link (normative scope).
default_signal_values_when_idle: SDA = HIGH, SCL = HIGH (both released, pulled up by Rp). The bus is 'free' after tBUF following a STOP condition.

low_power_modes.Non_Continuous_Clock: Clock Lane returns to LP-11 between bursts.
low_power_modes.BLLP_LP_substitution: Video Mode HBP/HFP intervals can substitute LP for Blanking Packets.

bus_clear_procedure: If SDA stuck LOW: master sends 9 SCL clock pulses to allow the device holding SDA LOW to release it. If SCL stuck LOW: use HW reset pin or cycle power.

pcb_integration_constraints.max_trace_length_cm: ≤ 30 (depends on data rate; shorter at 1.5+ Gbps).
pcb_integration_constraints.AC_coupling: NOT used — D-PHY is DC-coupled differential.

responsibilities: Pixel-to-Byte Packing Formats (RGB565/RGB666 Packed/RGB666 Loosely Packed/RGB888)

pcb_integration_constraints_inherited_fr.max_trace_length_cm: ≤ 30 cm at sub-Gbps rates; shorter at higher rates (per D-PHY).
pcb_integration_constraints_inherited_fr.AC_coupling: NOT used — D-PHY is DC-coupled differential.

integration_role: CSI-2 receiver IP integrates in the host SoC between the D-PHY/C-PHY macro and the image signal processor (ISP). The transmitter is the image sensor.
downstream: Unpacked pixels route by Virtual Channel / Data Type to the ISP (demosaic for RAW Bayer, color conversion for YUV/RGB).
